title: Career, Lemi Orhan Ergin
description: Positions held by Lemi Orhan Ergin since 2001, from Sony to Craftgate, with education and certifications.

blocks.text: I have been writing code since 2001. The orange branches are the two times I left Sony and came back.

items.title: Co-founder & Chief Software Crafter
items.note: A payment orchestration platform that connects online merchants to banks, payment providers and alternative payment methods through one integration.

items.title: Agile Practice Lead & Software Crafter
items.note: Led the cultural transformation of iyzico engineering around agile and lean thinking and software craftsmanship.

items.title: Managing Partner, Master Software Craftsman, Agile Coach & Trainer
items.note: Consulting and training for dozens of companies on agile culture and engineering practices.

items.title: Principal Software Engineer, Technical Lead & Agile Practice Lead
items.note: Also Solution Architect (Dec 2013 – May 2014), then Technical Architect & Scrum Master (May – Dec 2014).

items.title: [Certified ScrumMaster](https://www.scrumalliance.org/members/49418)
items.text: Scrum Alliance, 2009, trained by James Coplien
